# MINEBREAK

> Tactical voxel action & on-chain vault duels. Angled top-down combat, wave survival, and cryptographic commit-reveal duels on Ethereum Sepolia.

- Source: https://github.com/vaibhavi-0320/Minebreak
- Author: Vaibhavi — https://github.com/vaibhavi-0320/Minebreak
- Stack: React 19, Vite, React Three Fiber, Rapier 3D, Zustand, ethers.js v6, Solidity, Hardhat

## Summary

MINEBREAK is a browser-native voxel action and duel platform. Players can explore PvE wave survival in the voxel realm and engage in real-time, on-chain commit-reveal vault duels with testnet stakes on Ethereum Sepolia.
